newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgargas reduces supplies to debtor companies.
newsitem.headline: Bulgargas reduces supplies to debtor companies.

text.p: Bulgarian state gas supplier Bulgargas said on Thursday it was reducing supplies to major industrial customers who had not paid their bills.
A company statement said unless customers paid their bills, Bulgargas was unable to pay its Russian supplier, and was facing a drop in supply.
It said the reduction was effective from Thursday midday and companies affected included the Neftohim refinery and the Stomana and Kremikovtsi steelworks.

"From today, 30.1.97, 1200 hrs Bulgargas is introducing a limited regime for transfer of natural gas to: Agropolihim-Devnya, STIND-Sofia, Stomana-Pernik, Agrobiohim-Stara Zagora, Neftohim-Burgas, Antibiotic-Razgrad, Leko Co-Radomir, Kremikovtsi-Sofia, Plevenski cement, Devnya-cement, Neohim-Dimitrovgrad and others," it said.

"The enterprises indicated are almost half of the total number of consumers and have big sums of outstanding payments under contracts with Bulgargas for January which led to delayed payments by the company to the foreign supplier," it said.
Bulgargas said domestic consumers would not be affected and normal supplies would resume once the companies paid their bills.
Bulgaria is in severe economic crisis, its currency plummeting, inflation soaring, and the government warning of possible default on its $10 billion foreign debt.
